summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ETRACS CMCI Total Return ETN Series B (UCIB) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the UBS Bloomberg CMCI Composite index. The fund tracks a broad-commodity index representing five commodity sectors. It uses a set of five futures contracts of different maturities to maintain exposure to each commodity. UCIB was launched on Oct 8, 2015 and is issued by ETRACS.
